feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Burnham 'open' to slavery apology - as King continues Caribbean tour
articles.summary: Andy Burnham has said he is "open" to calls for Britain to make a formal apology for its role in the slave trade as the King continues his tour of the Caribbean.

articles.title: Poland's president turns back from Senegal trip as court chief's ousting sparks crisis
articles.summary: Riot police were deployed to Poland's Constitutional Tribunal on Friday as hundreds of demonstrators gathered to protest against the suspension of the top court's president by the current pro-European government.

articles.title: Ebola outbreak kills more than 5,000 people in Democratic Republic of Congo
articles.summary: More than 5,000 people have now died from an Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), according to government data.

articles.title: G20 photocall axed after Miliband and other ministers refuse to be pictured with top Russian diplomat
articles.summary: A photocall of foreign ministers was cancelled by the US after the UK's Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband and other European counterparts refused to be pictured with Russia's envoy Sergei Lavrov.

articles.title: Bugatti CEO chases down car thief - then offers him lift home
articles.summary: The head of the luxury car-maker Bugatti has promised to stop leaving his keys in his own car after his £2m model was stolen from a company site in Zagreb.

articles.title: AI-powered 'doorbell cameras' tested to alert people to approaching polar bears
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence-powered "doorbell cameras" are being tested by a team of international experts in Canada to warn communities about approaching polar bears as climate change increases the risk of dangerous encounters.

articles.title: Banished: The Taliban's War On Women - tickets go live for Sky News documentary screening
articles.summary: Tickets are now on sale for a screening, followed by a Q&A, of Alex Crawford's new documentary, Banished: The Taliban's War On Women.

articles.title: Crypto industry suffers 'largest bank heist in human history'
articles.summary: Cryptocurrency worth more than $6.3bn (£4.7bn) has been stolen from a major exchange - with one industry insider telling Sky News it is "the largest bank heist in human history".

articles.title: Why Google stock has plunged $500bn in a single day
articles.summary: Shares in Google's parent company Alphabet have suffered their worst-ever day on the US stock market, falling more than 12% and knocking around half a trillion dollars off its value.
